claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_movement_through_openings
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The inherited Gaseous Form effect includes a persistent movement capability that is not reducible to speed, teleport, or force-move. The surface has no atom for 'can pass through tiny openings' style form-state movement permission.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: the target can move through a space as small as 1 inch wide without squeezing

claude_proposed_widenings.name: EffectAtom.restrict_action_set
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The inherited spell effect forbids attacking and casting spells while gaseous. The v4 taxonomy already has restrict_action_set, but the current TS surface and tracer do not expose it as an EffectAtom, so the item cannot honestly encode the action restriction bundle it inherits.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The target can't attack or cast spells.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: DurationEndTrigger.self_dismisses_as_bonus_action
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The potion adds an item-specific voluntary end condition with explicit action economy. Current duration end triggers are passive events only; none model 'the bearer spends a Bonus Action to end the effect'.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: or until you end the effect as a Bonus Action
